description: Set Character panel, OpenType panel and CJK character attributes on text frames, a character range of each, or the selected text: font and style, size, leading, kerning, tracking, scales, baseline shift, rotation, language, caps, superscript and subscript, underline, strikethrough, fill and stroke, no break, overprint, ligatures, alternates, swashes, figure styles, fractions, ordinals, tsume, aki, tate-chu-yoko and warichu

baselineDirection.description: Characters in vertical text: standard, tate-chu-yoko or rotated

characterAlignment.description: Character alignment of mixed sizes in a line

color.description: Fill colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

connectionForms.description: Connection forms (Arabic and other joining scripts)

fontStyle.description: A style of the text's current font family, e.g. "Bold", "Italic" or "Bold Italic" (the family of the first character of each range)

kerning.description: Manual kerning in thousandths of an em, at each character of the range

kerningMethod.description: Automatic kerning: Metrics (metrics), Optical, Metrics - Roman Only, or none (0)

leading.description: Leading in points (turns off auto leading)

noBreak.description: No Break: keep these characters on one line

openTypePosition.description: OpenType position: superior, inferior, numerator or denominator glyphs

range.description: Characters to format in each frame (or in the selected text): start is the 0-based character offset; length defaults to the rest of the text. Default: all the text

strokeColor.description: Character stroke colour. A swatch name, "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black) or "none"

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true. Text frames inside groups are included; with selection: true and text selected with the Type tool, the selected text is used

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

tracking.description: Tracking in thousandths of an em

tsume.description: Tsume: percent of space removed around Japanese characters

warichu.description: Warichu: set the characters as inline notes

name: set_character_attributes
title: Set Character Attributes
